pages.title: Environmental Sound Reference
blocks: Sound recordings may contain traffic, voices, machinery, weather and bells.
An isolated sound does not identify a place. Record what you actually hear and compare it with independent information.
This reference cannot identify an unknown recording automatically.

pages.title: Notre-Dame-des-Anges — Clock Notice
blocks: The hour bell strikes on a twelve-hour cycle, including overnight. Three hour strikes occur at 03:00 and 15:00.
Maintenance note: the opening interval is short, followed by a longer interval before the third strike. In a three-strike sequence, the approximate onset times are 0, 1 and 4 seconds.
The repair committee insists this is a local tradition. The repair invoice calls it a sticking escapement.
The church stands beside the sea. Match the complete sequence, time and weather; one bell sound alone is not an address.

pages.title: Coastal Clock Service — Maintenance Bulletin
blocks: Service profiles for the three coastal town entries in this directory. Three-strike sequences are listed as seconds after the first strike.
: regular intervals — 0, 2, 4.
: delayed second strike — 0, 3, 4.
: delayed third strike — 0, 1, 4.
The figures describe strike spacing, not a time zone. Check the parish notice for operating hours. No one has successfully billed the sea for corrosion.
